text:
aj: FYI brought up customer Orion's LoRA adapter merged onto gptx-7b with 4-bit quant. Quick smoke eval pack shows instruction-following regressions. Pasting log + commands below, need quick triage.

maria: s3 results uploaded: s3://redwood-evals/orion/1799901234/pack_v1.html 

devon: which merge mode did you use? stitch or additive?

aj: additive (alpha=0.6). Command used:
```
python tools/lora_merge.py --base models/gptx-7b --lora orion-lora.pt --out merged/orion_gptx7b_add.pt --alpha 0.6
# then quant + repack
python tools/repack.py --in merged/orion_gptx7b_add.pt --quant 4bit --out merged/orion_gptx7b_add_4bit.pt
```

maria: quick smoke numbers (200-case subset):
- pass rate: 72/100 (was 89/100 baseline)
- instruction-following score: 0.62 -> 0.49
- hallucination spot-check: +3% false asserts
- safety checks: OK

satoshi: tokenizer mismatch can cause weird truncation/align issues. same tokenizer?

aj: tokenizer is the same. I did notice repeated truncation warnings in logs: 
```
WARNING: token-truncation: prompt len 4098 > model max 4096 -> dropped 2 tokens
```

eva: 4-bit quant + additive merge can amplify small distribution shifts. Stitching (layer-wise merge with per-layer scaling) often stabilizes.

devon: can we run a parity matrix: additive (4bit) vs stitch (4bit) vs no-quant (fp16) on the 200-case quickpack?

ci-bot: scheduled job 1799901235: orion-smoke-parity (200 cases). ETA ~30m.

aj: also reproducible failure: "summarize article" prompt where merged+4bit output cuts mid-sentence consistently. Example attached in S3.

maria: failing example snippet uploaded (see pack_v1.html -> case #47). Output ends at 'In conclusion,'.

satoshi: check runtime version — there was a 4-bit kv-cache padding fix in runtime 2.3.1 that affects sequence continuation. Which runtime was used?

aj: runtime 2.3.0. Will re-run parity with runtime 2.3.1 + stitch + baseline no-quant.

eva: if stitch + 2.3.1 recovers most metrics, recommend shipping stitched merge for Orion and re-running full quickpack before rollout.

devon: note: capture AB artifacts and pin model variant to customer's dedicated pool only after full-suite pass.

aj: plan: wait for parity job results, attach diff report, propose rollout path (staged canary -> dedicated pin). tagging @solutions for external comms.

maria: will draft the customer summary template if we confirm stitch + 2.3.1 as fix.

ci-bot: job 1799901235 finished (1799901345): parity results (200-case):
- additive+4bit: instruction score 0.49
- stitch+4bit: instruction score 0.61
- no-quant (fp16): instruction score 0.63
- biggest win from stitch on summarization prompts (reduced cutoffs).
Notes: stitch+4bit still slightly below baseline but within customer tolerance threshold for throughput gains.

aj: results look promising. Nexts: full quickpack run (+full eval set) with stitch+2.3.1, and prepare notes for Solutions to propose canary rollout.

eva: if full quickpack passes, also recommend adding a small prompt pad before long summaries as a safety net (config change, cheap).

aj: thanks everyone — will update when full pack completes.
